summary: This proposed standard defines a way to transport OSPFv3 packets over IPv4. Combined with the existing OSPFv3 Address Family extension, it can simplify moving from an IPv4-only OSPFv2 routing domain to a dual-stack OSPFv3 domain. It also updates RFC 5838 to support virtual links in the IPv4 unicast address family.

eli5.summary: Moving from an old road system to a new one is easier if the new trucks can still use the old roads for a while. This lets the newer routing system run over older roads during the switch.
